sections.heading: 1. A little every day
lines: ① Turn your head side to side, 5 each way.
② Shoulder rolls, 10 reps, a few times a day.
③ Short walks, and heat on tight muscles.
④ Ease back into driving and work gradually.

slides.heading: Seek medical care promptly if

caption:
Felt fine after a car accident, then woke up with a stiff neck? Neck pain appearing hours or a day or two later is common, and most people improve steadily over the following weeks.

First, if you have severe neck pain, arm numbness or weakness, dizziness, trouble swallowing or a bad headache, see a doctor or go to ED.

Otherwise, current guidelines favour staying active over resting in a collar. Gentle head turns, shoulder rolls, short walks and heat can help things settle. If you've lodged a CTP claim, bring your claim number.

Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio.
